node.statement: Row-corner transfer: the column-corner estimate implies, with the same universal constants and threshold, (1-C_col e)||Z|| <= ||J_{Q,P,n}(Z)|| <= (1+C_col e)||Z|| for every Z in M_n tensor S_{Q,P}, by the defining adjunction J_{Q,P,n}(Z)=J_{P,Q,n}(Z^dagger)^dagger.
